protocol.goal: Arithmetic mean net capital return of May/July/September 2026 >=10%, every May-September net month nonnegative. Preserve full continuous compounded capital, costs, settlement and pending holdings.
protocol.fit_cutoff: 00:00 ET, daily refit. Features use only completed/available observations by the decision. No month identity features.
protocol.label_release: Full 14 inclusive calendar day contract must have complete regular-session data; release at max(expiry+1s, all historical bar available_at). Same release rule for early profit, stop and expiry labels.
protocol.added_features: SOXX/QQQ 2,10,60-day return; 5/20/60-day moving-average distance, 20-day direction efficiency, 2/5-day RSI, 14-day true range, overnight gap and prior close position. ETF 14-day ATR determines entry-frozen risk width. All use prior completed daily bars only.

risk_rules.description: +5% take-profit or contractual expiry; no early stop
Same ATR stop, after +2% observed excursion raise to fee/slippage-adjusted breakeven after completed bar availability plus 30s latency

algorithms: ridge_pair: standardized ridge alpha=20 predicts paired return advantage, centered by per-ETF historical mean
boosted_log: HGB 80 iterations, 7 leaves, min leaf20, learning_rate .05, l2=5 predicts expected log(1+net trade return)
analog_tail: 40 nearest standardized compact context histories, inverse-distance weights; score mean log return plus 0.25*mean negative log return
quantile_tail: HGB with same parameters fits 20th/50th/80th net-return quantiles; score 0.5*median+0.25*upper+0.25*lower, with downside-floor diagnostic
protocol.prediction_correction: Each ML expert's per-ETF score is corrected by mean(realized log return - its old as-of score) over last 60 mature prediction dates, minimum 40. No refreshed-fit predictions in the residual sample. Select higher corrected positive score, else cash.
protocol.selector: One pre-registered daily router, not an after-case winner: score each expert's most recent 63 mature decision dates with zero for cash using mean(log return/max(held_sessions,1)) minus 0.5*standard deviation/sqrt(max(number of dates/5,1)). Require at least 12 issued choices, positive mean net log return and positive penalized score. Choose highest score (stable ID tie-break); if no expert qualifies use cash. Only past as-of forecasts and outcomes released before today are used.
protocol.capital: Single position, 100% of settled cash at permitted entry, no same-day reentry, T+1 modeled settlement. No additional account leverage. Fixed exposure restores original v2 capital scale to test the 10% goal; drawdown and double-cost results are mandatory, no monthly return clipping.
protocol.selection_boundary: Hyperparameters, routes, risk, exposure and selector frozen by this registration before v5 case results. May/July labels may train/select later once mature; not earlier. All expert case results are diagnostic, not a post-hoc admission selector. Retain all attempts and failures.
protocol.simulation: Reuse v2/v3 raw prices, corporate actions, fees, adverse gaps, stop-first ambiguous bars and delayed protection. Existing holdings retain their entry-selected risk contract even when daily model changes.
